I'll read the brief in full first and follow it exactly.STILL SHOP HOMEWORK — anchored list

- SPINE L16: “(the Anderson Method house rules).” A stranger does not have this shop’s house rules. Same in SKILL L130: “Honor the Anderson house rules.”
- SPINE L67–68: “the Amendment Law prefers the rule that leaves a trace.” The Amendment Law was already cut. Dead shop pointer.
- SPINE L70–72: “an external multi-agent writeup measured ~15x the tokens…” Measured citation. The gate is law; the number is homework.
- SPINE L181: “a spend limit protects CASH and not a prepaid ALLOWANCE, and an agent can exhaust the month’s included pool without charging a further penny.” This shop’s prepaid-pool scar.
- SPINE L307: “The three-question interview above is a declaration.” There is no interview above. Leftover from the cut plan-card / posture map.
- SPINE L316–317: “an Antigravity/Gemini host running a Claude model…” Concrete shop host. The rule (host brand ≠ lineage) is law; this pairing is our wiring. Same operationalized in SKILL L133–137 as “the Overflow Valve, billed to Google’s tab.”
- SPINE L347–348: “boss ruling 2026-07-24: this line lives in the ticket’s small print and is never narrated in the story voice.” Date + SHOW/TRM voice. The LAWS line can stay; the ruling/story-voice does not.
- SPINE L352–375 entire: episode folder `episodes/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/`, “Style law (boss ruling 2026-07-24),” “ENDING CREDITS — show tiers only,” “filmed on location · 2026-07-23 → 2026-07-24,” “The dispatch deck does NOT roll credits,” screenshot filing, “RE-COMPRESSED to economical JPEG (cap ~1280px… quality ~70),” “uploads arrive under `.claude\uploads\`,” ffmpeg/Pillow, “harvest source for end-of-project bottling.” This is our show/harvest pipeline. A stranger’s first job does not need it.
- SPINE L407: “Which concrete model that is, is the shop’s wiring (`SPINE-WIRING.md`).” Honest pointer — then SKILL L141–144 loads the illustration anyway: “Codex is usually the sharpest CODE reviewer when it didn’t build it (Claude/Grok/Gemini code → Codex)…”
- SPINE L468–476 “The three flips” + “Practical scars”: “The builder seat has flipped for three causes — capability, price, infrastructure — and in each flip the cold reviewer surfaced defects…” Our history. Residue worth keeping is listed under the 5,000-token engine; the flips narrative is not.
- SPINE L529–531 / L631–657: Deck vendor map (🟠 Claude · 🔵 Codex · ⚫ Grok · 🟢 Gemini), CREW character binding, “v4.2 (boss-adopted 2026-08-23),” “v4.0 repealed the 2026-08-09 marks, including 🟣-as-building,” Cursor transport 🟣➤, bloodlines 🌙 Moonshot · 🔷 Zhipu · 🎼 Cursor, “🟣➤🌙 💸 Kimi K3 reviewing,” “LEADING 🔴 is Butch’s character color,” “🩷⚫ Cassidy (in grok) 📝.” Shop arsenal + crew costume + changelog.
- SPINE L547–553: “bumped r1 → r2 on 2026-07-22, when ‘another vendor’s account’ was tightened…” Block-id archaeology.
- SPINE L566: “*(Boss ruling 2026-08-24.)*” Date stamp on Meter Law §3.
- SPINE L574: “v2.3, rewritten v2.5 on the boss’s ruling 2026-08-24.” Changelog in the loaded engine.
- SPINE L599–601: “`mcp-seats/allowance.py` holds the record.” This repo’s path.
- SPINE L603: “added v2.0, 2026-08-22.” Date.
- SPINE L608: “Wiring, wrapper scripts, and install commands live with the Deck (`mcp-seats/` …).” Shop path inside the law.
- SPINE L629: “Kept in the trunk on the 2026-08-24 council’s ruling.” Meta about yesterday’s council, loaded today.
- SPINE L676–692 “WIRING & FIELD NOTES” + the four load-before-act triggers, especially “before a seat preflight or the first dispatch of a session — you cannot probe an arsenal you have not read.” This forces every stranger to ingest *this shop’s* `SPINE-WIRING.md` (our CLI paths, model strings, lineage-ledger location) before any seat is summoned. That is the owner’s exact failure mode: paid tokens circling in our setup notes before work hits MCP.
- SKILL L3 / L6: arsenal commercial (“Gemini-Antigravity incl. Nano Banana”); “Reserved future rebrand, coined 2026-07-17: ‘Agentic Dispatch Director’.”
- SKILL L40: “Claude/Fable conducting.” This shop’s conductor.
- SKILL L50–54: “this file carried a stale v4.0 against SPINE’s v4.2 for two days, telling the conductor that purple meant nothing…” Incident scar.
- SKILL L59–72 FUEL MODE: “boss-adopted 2026-08-24”; ADHD register for this boss. A stranger did not ask for ` /dispatch fuel`.
- SKILL L74–87 PERSISTENT SEATS: “installed & verified 2026-08-22”; table `wmw-codex` / `wmw-grok` / `wmw-gemini`; “Wrapper source: `C:\Sync\Projects\andersons-dispatch-deck\mcp-seats\`”; “two headless croak-killers found 2026-08-22: a 60-minute timeout (agy’s default was 5 minutes… ) and an `always_approve` switch.” Absolute path on this box + dated croak-killers. How-to-summon *pattern* is law (Transport Law). These paths, dates, and war stories are not.
- SKILL L103–126 THE RESERVE BENCH: Cursor 🟣➤ pool, `BENCH-LEDGER.md`, `MEASURING-POOLS.md`, `mcp-seats/read-meters.py`, `bench-burn.py` (already cut from engine; still named in the loader). This shop’s metered Cursor bench.
- SKILL L164–167: ON INVOCATION requires `SPINE-WIRING.md` “which this step REQUIRES you to load first” + `claude mcp list`. Our arsenal file + our harness, every summon.

CEREMONY — anchored list

Restatements of a rule already in force (second and later copies; the first copy is not ceremony):

- Builder never reviewer, restated: Principle 3 (SPINE L116–118) · Part IV “Still Principle 3” (L182–184) · declared-seat-lineage (L189–195) · anti-laundering (L197–204) · Transport Law §2–3 (L613–620) · Review dispatch “Who may review” (L399–403) · SKILL L89–97 transport doctrine · SKILL L138–141 · SKILL L155–157 · invariant block bullet 1 (SPINE L538–539 and again SKILL L182–183). One statement is the method. Nine are a sermon.
- “Gates pass, never ‘it works’”: Ladder (SPINE L34–35) · Principle 5 (L122–124) · Part V §4 (L227) · mission reports (L466) · SKILL L147–148 · invariant block bullet 2, twice.
- Dispatch gate / right-size / council-is-special: Part I §2 (L51–68) *then* “It is deliberately restated at the dispatch gate and THE COUNCIL” (L66–68) · Part VI “The dispatch gate” (L279–286) · THE COUNCIL (L420–439) · Council Seat Law §6 (L592–593) · SKILL L129, L153. The engine already knows it is repeating itself.
- Cap the loop: Principle 8 (L129–134) · Escalation (L389–396) · Council step 5 (L454–455) · Part VII one-exchange (L496–498) · autonomous-hours bell (L509–513).
- Human judges / merges: Principle 6 (L125) · Principle 10 (L140–146) · Council step 6 (L456) · SKILL L150 · SKILL L158 · invariant bullets 3–4, twice.
- Preflight / probe-transport-not-binary: Part VI (L306–338) · Transport Law §4 (L621–623) · SKILL L89–101 · SKILL ON INVOCATION step 2 (L164–175).
- Meter / spend-loudly: Meter Law (L557–569) · Notation meter marks (L663–670) · SKILL L108–122 · SKILL L133.
- Signature / color: Principle 1 (L109–113) · Part VIII (L528–531) · THE NOTATION (L628–670) · SKILL NARRATE IN COLOR (L38–46) · SKILL THE LEGEND (L48–57).
- SKILL L34–36 then L128–150 “RUNNING THE DECK (all mechanics are SPINE’s — this is the plain-render checklist)” and L152 “NON-NEGOTIABLES (all inherited from SPINE — restated only as the tier’s guardrail card)”: the loader admitting it is reprinting the engine.
- SKILL L179–189: invariant block copied verbatim *after* SPINE is always loaded. Principle 9 wants this when the doctrine might *not* be opened. This loader always opens it. Duplicate spend.
- SKILL L48–57 “The Deck does not keep its own copy of the marks. Read THE NOTATION in SPINE” — then spends a paragraph on a two-day stale-legend incident instead of stopping.

Rules a competent orchestrator already follows, or that restated another rule:

- SPINE L1–16 “One owner per fact / Neither CREW nor SHOW restates SPINE / brand-neutral definition.” Inheritance manifesto for editors of the method, not operators of a first job. Two sentences would do; this is a preamble.
- SPINE L4–5 “Any content change bumps this line — a silent edit under an old tag is banned.” Editor rule, not runtime rule.
- Part VII L501 “Grade the work, not the worker.” Professionalism.
- Part VII L499–500 “Nits don’t multiply.” Taste. Already covered by MINOR + cap.
- Part VII L487–488 circle-backs essay: already implied by “reviews never stop the line” (L483–486).
- Council L450 “never invented.” Fraud prohibition they do not need written.
- Transport Law §1 “Vendors are suggestions, never requirements… one command removes it.” Install courtesy; not first-job law.
- Notation state soup (SPINE L660–662): 🚩🚧🧪🩺🕵️🏁🚢🪦🟤. Status-light cosplay. Mission reports already demand outcome-first one-liners.
- “A splash of hypotheses loses to one honest measurement” (SPINE L82–83) and “four characters litigating paint” (L522): voice, not procedure.

THE 5,000-TOKEN ENGINE — what survives, specifically

Budget: ~5,000 tokens total, SKILL + SPINE, always-loaded. Nothing else. No new files. These existing clauses, once each, in this order. Everything not named here does not load.

**SKILL (~400 tokens)**
- YAML `name` + one-line description (orchestration, plain, no persona). Cut the arsenal commercial, Nano Banana, rebrand date.
- DEPENDS SPINE >= 2.8; on activation read the version line; mismatch → HALT.
- Load receipt: `🟡➤ ADD loaded · spine <parsed> · render: plain`.
- Delta in one breath: render SPINE plain; conductor 🟡➤; workers by MODEL name.
- ON INVOCATION: (1) load SPINE (2) probe which seats *answer in this session* and declare independence status (3) ask “What’s the job?”
- Stop. No fuel mode, no MCP table, no croak-killers, no Overflow Valve, no fit-routing illustration, no restated non-negotiables, no second invariant block, no `SPINE-WIRING.md` as a mandatory pre-dispatch read.

**SPINE (~4,600 tokens) — surviving clauses, once**

Header: version line `spine vX.Y (date)` + “the method lives here; launchers render it.” Cut CREW/SHOW/Anderson-Method namedrop, bump-procedure, brand-neutral essay.

Part I, all four structures, compressed not deleted:
- Ladder of Truth: the five rungs (L26–32) + “Gates pass, never ‘it works’” + vendor answer is a CLAIM (L36–39) + a gate must be able to FAIL / RED-first / untested test is opinion (L40–44) + “Any two without the third = not yet” (L46) + “Ambiguity is a finding, never an input” / “‘I could not tell what you meant’ is a good outcome” (L47–49).
- Gate-0: two questions (L55–57); both no → just do it; the gate decides who BUILDS, never whether the result is REVIEWED (L58–61). Right-size: one builder + one cross-vendor reviewer is the canon; a 3+ PANEL is a SPECIAL move, proposed in one line (why + rough cost), dispatched only on explicit go (L62–66, L69). Cut Amendment-Law leftover and the 15x citation.
- Diagnose / Design fork: bug → instrument; gnarly feature → *propose* a council, never auto-fire (L80–88). Re-classify when the shape changes (L89–90).
- Reality Contract table, all five rows (L97–103).

Ten Principles as their numbered law sentences (L109–146), including: P1 one-line caveat “signature identifies the declared seat, not a verified model”; P8 units (ROUND / EXCHANGE) and the three caps; P10 “re-plan around the block; never assume he is at the keyboard; if a step needs him at the machine, say so.” Cut P9’s entry-file stamping mechanics (install-time). Keep the four abstract roles as four bullets (L149–158).

Fleet-legality (L165–186): Declared · Bounded (atomic reservation, not a check) · Destined (“An agent with no destination still spends at full rate”) · Accounted · Governed where it RUNS (vendor control plane, not our config file) · Still Principle 3 · Authority inheritance. Declared-seat-lineage clause (L189–195). Anti-laundering: “a name is not a lineage”; two legal review paths only — different effective-model vendor+lineage, or boss-launched fresh seat; fail closed on UNKNOWN (L197–204, L326–328). Cut Continuity/successor (L206–209).

Adjudication (L218–266), all six: per-finding ACCEPT/DISPUTE; BLOCKER/MATERIAL/MINOR/NOT PROVEN with failure mechanism + repro; repairs get a fresh review; claims capped; **three lists and containment** — write set frozen in the ticket, actual delta from the repo (`git diff --name-status` + `git status --porcelain`), review manifest with reviewer-computed hashes; `actual delta ⊆ write set` AND `actual delta ⊆ review manifest`; disputed BLOCKER/MATERIAL: testable → RED test whose oracle is outside the test author’s lineage; untestable → strongest falsifiable evidence, never NOT PROVEN because nobody automated it. Close: “Models do not negotiate their way to consensus. … A ruling is.”

Mechanics, one copy (do not reprint Part I §2):
- Routing table FRONTIER / WORKHORSE / FAST (L289–295). Cheapest seat that *clearly* clears the bar; new billing surface asked first (L296–299). Thin budget: never cut the adversarial channel (L302–304).
- Preflight, once (L306–338): probe reachability in *this* session; effective model+lineage behind the host, never CLI name/host brand/account; probe the capability the ticket needs; probe the transport not the binary; UNKNOWN LINEAGE never counts as cross-vendor; print `FULL CROSS-VENDOR` / `SOLO-VENDOR DEGRADED` / `REVIEW UNAVAILABLE`; solo vendor while the boss is asleep = `REVIEW UNAVAILABLE`, queue UNREVIEWED. Cut “three-question interview.”
- Ticket sections (L341–350): TASK (reviewer tickets get the boss’s ORIGINAL words) · EXPECTED OUTCOME · CONTEXT as paths · CONSTRAINTS · MUST DO (verify command) · MUST NOT (no undeclared spawns) · OUTPUT FORMAT · WRITE SET mandatory · LAWS by reference. Load-bearing line on every builder ticket: *“‘I could not tell what you meant’ is a good outcome. Propose, don’t guess.”*
- WRITE SET fence for parallel: provably disjoint, including manifests/lockfiles; overlap → serialize or worktree; no git → parallel writes forbidden (L376–380).
- Worker statuses, first line: `DONE` · `DONE_WITH_CONCERNS` · `NEEDS_CONTEXT` · `BLOCKED` (L382–387).
- Escalation 1–4 (L390–396). Never a third identical retry.
- Review dispatch: two legal paths; reviewer ticket carries exactly four things — original task verbatim, uncurated review set, diff + acceptance, verify command+output; never the builder’s reasoning; broken tooling → hand the code via stdin; “The adversarial channel is the last thing you let fail.” (L398–418). Residue of the three flips, one line: seat map is mission state; if the reviewer cannot read the repo, hand it the code; the builder does not commit its own work (L470–475, stripped of history).
- Council, as the special-move kernel not a second doctrine: consent-gated; propose why+cost; explicit go; no genuine need for N perspectives → no council (L430–439). Procedure as six one-liners (L442–456): Brief (question verbatim, numbered points) · distinct lenses, no seat sees another first · signed real reads · synthesize with every idea attributed and every disagreement NAMED · two rounds then the bell · boss rules. Cut “when NOT” examples, tier-dressing, and every restatement of Gate-0.
- Mission reports (L463–466): phone-readable; outcome first; per-seat one-liners; rulings as options to react to; cost note on fan-out; never “it works.”

Review-culture kernel (not the essay): reviews never stop the line — only a BLOCKER or the emergency brake halt the *affected* lane (L483–486, L502–505). Every finding ships a suggested fix (L494–495). Tone/nits: one EXCHANGE, then the ruling queue, work continues (L496–498). Autonomous hours: two rounds per debate then the bell; unresolved → decision queue, back to work (L509–513). Unreachable boss: safest honest version, assumption loud, queue it — the one exception to “ambiguity is a finding” (L518–521).

Part VIII: “Every message from a seat ends with its color” (L528). Invariant block VERBATIM once (L536–545). Cut the r2 changelog and CREW binding.

Meter Law §1–4 (L559–569) without the date and without loading `MEASURING-POOLS.md`. Council Seat Law §1–6 (L578–593): spend is gated, not vendor class; allowance is a bound; unknown cost fails closed; consent to spend is not consent to convene. Cut `allowance.py` path. Transport Law §1–5 (L610–626): opt-in; fresh call is blind — necessary not sufficient; reply-chain stays in lineage; probe the transport; CLI one-shot remains the fallback. Cut `mcp-seats/` and wrapper install.

Notation kernel only (the rest is costume): seat color visible on every act; BUILDING and REVIEWING are different marks so `same-color build then same-color review` is legible self-review; ⛔ for blocked/needs-boss; council asks first; **meter mark mandatory on any line that can spend** (♾️ included · 💸 bills · ⚠️ unknown, fail closed) (L635–638, L643–645, L663–670). Cut bloodlines, Cursor-arrow theology, Butch/Cassidy exception, state emoji list, v4.0/v4.2 changelog.

Cut entirely from load: episode folder + credits + visuals; WIRING trigger list (do not load `SPINE-WIRING.md` on a summon); THE NOTATION encyclopedia; Fuel mode; Reserve Bench operational chapter; Overflow Valve; croak-killer narrative; absolute paths.

WHAT I'D REGRET

Badly:
- **Headless Gemini/Grok stalls.** The 60-minute timeout and `always_approve` croak-killers (SKILL L85–87) are why a first real *build* ticket through this method’s MCP seats actually returns. They must not load every summon — the owner is right — but a stranger who installed these wrappers and never reads the docs will watch a 5-minute default kill a live build, then retry, then burn the window the method exists to protect. Install-time, not runtime. Loss is real if docs are not actually read.
- **Three-list containment, if anyone “compresses” it further.** Drop hashes or “delta from the repo, never the builder’s account” and review becomes a curated vibe check. That is the method’s teeth. I kept it. I would regret any 5,000-token pass that trades it for slogans.
- **Council procedure going to six one-liners.** First time a stranger *does* convene, two seats will share a lens and the synthesis will smooth a disagreement. Recoverable: the one-liners still name the failure. Not fatal.

Medium:
- **No named artifact folder.** Principle 4 still says files are the shared brain, but without `episodes/…` tickets scatter. First job still works; later audit/bottling does not. Acceptable — that pipeline is ours.
- **Antigravity-hosts-Claude as a named example.** Without one concrete rented-brain, they will count host brand as independence and stamp `FULL CROSS-VENDOR` on a laundered review. I kept the *rule*; I cut the Overflow Valve as a standing route. That example is the one shop-named sentence I would fight to put back *inside the preflight clause* if a token is found — it is the trap, not the wiring chart.
- **Fit-routing (Codex-for-code, etc.).** Strangers will send reviews to whoever is idle. Principle 7 + “route by FIT” one-liner still covers it. Shop’s Codex-is-sharpest table is homework and should stay homework.

Mild / none:
- Fuel mode, rebrand, ending credits, JPEG caps, bloodlines, Butch vs 🔴, version archaeology, “three flips” war story, Amendment Law ghost, wiring-load-before-dispatch. Zero regret. Those are how a stranger burns 16k tokens before a seat is summoned.

The 5,000-token cut still does the owner’s four-move machine: *where* (Gate-0 + FRONTIER/WORKHORSE/FAST + independence preflight), *how* (Transport Law pattern, not our paths), *in front of the model* (ticket + write set + reviewer-four), *back to the user* (statuses + three lists + capped adjudication + phone report). What it refuses to do is make them pay for our scars, our Cursor pool, our show, and our third reprint of Principle 3 before that machine turns over.

CONFIDENCE

High on what is shop homework and what is a restatement: every item above is a quoted load-bearing line, including dead pointers (Amendment Law, “three-question interview”) and the wiring-trigger that re-imports this shop on every summon.

Medium on the 5,000-token fit: Part I four structures + ten principles + fleet/lineage + three lists + ticket/review contracts + three spend/transport laws is the honest minimum for *amazing* first-job results, not a manifesto. Tighter than that and they know they should be honest and not swarm, but not *how to summon or what to put in the ticket* — which is how they circle, which is the fear. Notation-kernel vs full grammar is the softest call; I kept the self-review-visible marks and spend marks, cut the costume.

I am not defending SPINE-WIRING.md, episodes, Fuel, Reserve Bench, or any second copy of a law. I am defending Gate-0, the Reality Contract, declared-seat-lineage, three-list containment, the reviewer-four, fail-closed UNKNOWN, Destined (“cost scales with DISPATCH”), and meter-on-every-spend-line. A stranger cannot luck into those.
